request: Fix parseRecordId(raw) for loan record identifiers. Return a positive safe integer only for a string of 1 to 16 ASCII digits with no leading zero. Return null for every other input. Preserve the existing exported function and avoid adding dependencies.
before: export function parseRecordId(raw) { return parseInt(raw, 10) || null; }

request: Implement isOverdue(dueOn,today) for library loans using calendar dates in YYYY-MM-DD form, years 1000 to 9999. The due day itself is not overdue; later days are. Validate both inputs as real dates, including leap years, and throw RangeError for invalid inputs. No time zone conversion or ambient clock: today is explicitly injected. Preserve the module and exported function.
before: export function isOverdue(dueOn,today) { return today >= dueOn; }

request: Correct the library loan authorization guard canBorrow(user). Only a user object with role exactly borrower and a positive safe integer id may borrow. Bookseller and all other roles must be denied. Null, arrays, malformed objects and invalid ids must return false. Do not mutate the input. Keep a pure function; do not implement login, a database, or a new authentication scheme.
checks: assert.equal(mod.canBorrow({id:1,role:'borrower'}),true); for(const user of [null,undefined,[],{},'borrower',{id:1,role:'bookseller'},{id:1,role:'admin'},{id:0,role:'borrower'},{id:1.5,role:'borrower'},{id:'1',role:'borrower'},{id:NaN,role:'borrower'},{id:Infinity,role:'borrower'},{id:Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER+1,role:'borrower'}]) assert.equal(mod.canBorrow(user),false); const u=Object.freeze({id:2,role:'borrower'}); assert.equal(mod.canBorrow(u),true);
